items.mainDefect: Parallel initialization workers race on the captured err variable.

secondary.defect: Parallel initialization workers increment totalBatchesIndexed without synchronization, creating a data race and potentially an incorrect count.

items.mainDefect: Skipping the PostgreSQL test prevents it from catching module or storage server initialization regressions.

secondary.defect: The PostgreSQL test configuration hardcodes localhost instead of using the configured database connection settings, likely causing the Drone failure.

items.mainDefect: Calling Init during construction makes initialization failures abort construction and block startup without adapting existing callers.

secondary.defect: Every constructor call now blocks synchronously on the full search index build.
Initialization uses the internal watcher admin context instead of the caller's context, and sync.Once prevents a later Init call from correcting this.

items.mainDefect: Parallel initialization workers race on the unsynchronized totalBatchesIndexed counter.

secondary.defect: Parallel initialization workers race on the captured err variable, allowing one worker to overwrite another worker's error.
